name: Cooper Residence
summary: The Cooper Residence is a dilapidated home located on the western fringes of Moonbrook in Westfall. Once the dwelling of the Cooper family, it now lies abandoned and pillaged alongside the rest of the ruined town. For travelers picking through the wreckage of Moonbrook, the house serves as a stark reminder of the ordinary lives displaced by the rise of the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Ruined Homestead
sections.body: Standing amid the dust and decay of Moonbrook, the Cooper Residence was once a quiet family dwelling before crime and poverty engulfed the region. When the Defias Brotherhood seized control of Moonbrook and turned it into their regional hub, the honest folk living here were driven away or forced into hiding. Today, the building sits ransacked and stripped of comfort, surrounded by outlaws and hostile prowlers, leaving behind little more than forgotten journals and old newspapers discarded on the floorboards.

faq.answer: The Coopers were an ordinary human family living in Moonbrook prior to the collapse of Westfall's local government. Like many villagers, they were forced to abandon their home when the Defias Brotherhood overtook the settlement, leaving their property to decay.

faq.q: What can be found inside the house?
faq.answer: Scattered on the floor of the abandoned residence are forgotten texts from Moonbrook's past, including old issues of The Moonbrook Times and a dusty journal that sheds light on the local turmoil.

Moonbrook was once the thriving center of Westfall's rural community. When the House of Nobles failed to pay the Stonemasons Guild after rebuilding Stormwind, Edwin VanCleef formed the Defias Brotherhood, claiming the struggling frontier towns and driving the residents away.

faq.q: Is the Cooper Residence safe to explore?
faq.answer: Not at all. The surrounding streets of Moonbrook crawl with hostile Defias highwaymen, thieves, and outlaws who attack anyone daring to trespass on their territory.

angles.text: The ruined home stands as a quiet indictment of Stormwind's neglect, showing what happens to ordinary kingdom subjects when the crown abandons its frontier settlements.
For humans walking through Moonbrook, homes like the Cooper Residence illustrate the tragic collateral damage wrought by the bitter dispute between the Stormwind nobility and the Stonemasons.
